<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a standard PKGBUILD for packaging Gauche, an R7RS Scheme implementation. The file follows ordinary packaging practices:

- **Source**: Downloads from the official upstream GitHub releases (https://github.com/shirok/Gauche/releases/download/...) which is the project's standard distribution channel.
- **Checksums**: Uses b2sums for integrity verification.
- **Build**: Standard `./configure`/`make` workflow with reasonable flag adjustments for mbedtls3 paths (`-I/usr/include/mbedtls3`, `-L/usr/lib/mbedtls3`).
- **Package**: Standard `make install-pkg install-doc` to `$pkgdir`, followed by installing the BSD license and setting reproducible-build timestamps on info pages.

There are no suspicious patterns: no obfuscated code, no unexpected `curl`/`wget` calls to non-upstream hosts, no `eval` of decoded blobs, no data exfiltration, no backdoors, and no system modifications beyond what the package needs. The commented-out `check()` block acknowledges known upstream test failures, which is transparent and appropriate.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>Standard PKGBUILD for Gauche, no malicious indicators.</summary>
</security_assessment>
